notes: Of nine attributions, one is accurate (Ulam p.21), five partial (Ulam's 'come to Eden's conclusions' not found, nearest text p.22-23 says the reverse about magnitude; Crosby's words accurate, 'supported Eden' an interpretation; Mayr p.30 accurate but the 'this conference' sentence is not in the volume; Eden's inputs restated; Schützenberger's conclusion reworded) and three misread (the 'I don't know' exchange and the topology remark are Schützenberger's and Levins's at p.79, not Lewontin's; the apology is Bossert's at p.40, not Eden's; Eden called his 2.7e6 'not implausible').
